title: Signature Section segmentation — Scientific Paper Extractor
description: Signature original — Headings (Abstract, Methods, Results) partition papers into typed sections. Segmentation structures the paper. Sections organize. This record documents a Signature-authored original method of the JAH archive toolkit, clearly labeled as Signature work rather than a public record.
demo:
# Paper extraction: split into sections by headings, pull abstract/methods/results/references.
text = """Abstract\nWe study X.\nMethods\nWe measured.\nResults\nIt worked.\nReferences\n[1] Y.""".replace("\\n", "\n")
import re
heads = ["abstract", "introduction", "methods", "results", "discussion", "conclusion", "references"]
secs, cur = {}, None
for line in text.splitlines():
    low = line.strip().lower()
    hit = next((h for h in heads if low == h or low.startswith(h + ":")), None)
    if hit:
        cur = hit; secs[cur] = []
    elif cur:
        secs[cur].append(line)
for h in heads:
    if h in secs:
        body = " ".join(secs[h])[:60]
        print(f"[{h.upper()}] {body}")
refs = [l for l in secs.get("references", []) if l.strip()]
print(f"references found: {len(refs)}")
provenance: Signature-authored original method created for the JAH archive toolkit; clearly labeled Signature, not a public record.
